text:
Rae M: Heads-up - Sales has a pilot ask called 'Onramp Kickstart'. Customer wants a single onramp SKU that bundles reserved baseline, a 2-week high-burst window, priority routing, and a refundable warm-node deposit. They want pricing + clear upgrade path to Dedicated. Need product checklist to evaluate.

Jon K: quick take - bundling simplifies sales but complicates billing and ops. We should treat the 2-week high-burst as a timeboxed feature with explicit burn rules and a surge rate. Also need rules for converting warm-node deposit to committed hours if upgraded.

Priya V: legal note - refundable deposit OK but must be timebound and have clear forfeiture conditions if terms violated. no open-ended burst exemptions. I'll draft a short exhibit: burst bands, approval flow, liability cap = fees paid last 12 months.

Elena S: docs + AE enablement: we need an entitlements table and three example billing scenarios (conservative/expected/high). also a one-paragraph explanation of what 'priority routing' means in practice.

ops-bot: created feature-flag "onramp_kickstart" in staging. config: {"owner":"product","default":false}. Will add dashboard tile.

Jon K: ops requirements - per-tenant metrics at 1m granularity, alert when burst >3x baseline for >15m, and an auto-throttle to baseline when credits exhausted. Warm-nodes must be pre-approved and non-refundable hours accounted for in bookings.

finance-bot: note: refundable deposit requires billing flow changes; need webhook to track deposit vs consumed warm-hours. Raising ticket FIN-4510.

Rae M: Proposed go/no-go checklist:
1) pricing worked up for 3 burn scenarios (Jon)
2) legal exhibit drafted (Priya)
3) docs one-pager + entitlements (Elena)
4) feature-flag + telemetry + alerts (ops)
5) billing hook + deposit handling (finance)

Rae M: I'll coordinate with AE and book a 30m sign-off Thursday. Please post short updates here. :thumbsup:
